title: HMRC tools and calculators
text:
Alcohol Duty

 Tool 
 What it does 

 Work out your Small Producer Relief 
 Check if you’re eligible for Small Producer Relief on Alcohol Duty and how much relief you can get 

 Capital Allowances

 Tool 
 What it does 

 Check if you can claim the super-deduction 
 Find out if you can claim super-deduction or special rate first year allowances, if you’re a company 

 Work out the balancing charge when you dispose of assets 
 Work out the balancing charge when you dispose of or sell plant or machinery after claiming the super-deduction or 50% special rate allowance 

 Check if you can claim full expensing or 50% first year allowances 
 If you’re a company, find out if you can claim full expensing or the 50% first year allowance on plant or machinery costs 

 Calculate your hybrid rate of writing down allowance 
 Work out your hybrid rate of writing down allowance, if your accounting period includes the day the rate changed 

 Capital Gains Tax

 Tool 
 What it does 

 Non-resident Capital Gains Tax 
 Calculate your non-resident Capital Gains Tax 

 Capital Gains Tax shares calculator 
 Calculate your Capital Gains Tax on the sale of shares 

 Capital Gains Tax property calculator 
 Calculate your Capital Gains Tax on the sale of property 

 Capital Gains Tax adjustment calculator for the 2024 to 2025 tax year 
 Work out the adjustment for your Self Assessment tax return for disposals of assets on or after 30 October 2024, when the rates changed. 

 Certificates of tax deposit

 Tool 
 What it does 

 Certificate of Tax Deposit interest calculator 
 Check the level of interest due against a tax deposit you have already made under the Certificate of Tax Deposit scheme 

 Compliance checks

 Tool 
 What it does 

 Get help if HMRC contacts you about a compliance check 
 Find guidance, videos and information about what to do if HMRC contacts you about compliance checks 

 Corporation Tax

 Tool 
 What it does 

 No Corporation Tax due 
 Tell HMRC you have no Corporation Tax due 

 Corporation Tax using CHAPS (Cumbernauld) 
 Request to pay Corporation Tax by CHAPS to HMRC Cumbernauld 

 Corporation Tax using CHAPS (Shipley) 
 Request to pay Corporation Tax by CHAPS to HMRC Shipley 

 Overlap relief calculator 
 If you’re self-employed or in a partnership, use this calculator to work out your overlap relief figure for Self Assessment for the 2023 to 2024 tax year. 

 Child Benefit and Child Trust Fund

 Tool 
 What it does 

 Child Benefit tax calculator 
 Check if you need to pay the High Income Child Benefit Tax Charge 

 Child Trust Fund locator 
 Work out where your Child Trust Fund is held 

 Childcare

 Tool 
 What it does 

 Check what help you could get with childcare costs 
 Find out how much you could get towards approved childcare 

 Deadlines

 Tool 
 What it does 

 Check your tax filing and payment deadlines 
 Find out the filing and payment deadlines for your taxes and add them to your calendar 

 Employment status and off-payroll working (IR35)

 Tool 
 What it does 

 Check employment status for tax 
 Check the employment status of a worker or if off-payroll working (IR35) rules apply to a contract 

 Gambling duties

 Tool 
 What it does 

 Machine Games Duty registered business 
 Search businesses by postcode 

 HMRC App

 Tool 
 What it does 

 HMRC App 
 A quick and easy way to get information about your tax, National Insurance, tax credits and benefits 

 Import and export

 Tool 
 What it does 

 System for the Exchange of Excise Data ( SEED ) on the European Commission website 
 Check whether your SEED Excise ID is valid 

 UK Trade Tariff tool 
 Classify your goods for import or export using the UK Trade Tariff, based on the EU TARIC (Tariff Integre Communautaire) 

 Income Tax

 Tool 
 What it does 

 Estimate your Income Tax for a previous tax year 
 Use this service to estimate how much Income Tax you should have paid for a previous tax year 

 Estimate your Income Tax for the current year 
 Estimate how much Income Tax and National Insurance you should pay for the current tax year 

 Inheritance Tax

 Tool 
 What it does 

 Inheritance Tax checker 
 Get an approximate value of an estate and decide if any Inheritance Tax is likely to be due 

 Inheritance Tax interest calculator 
 Calculate how much interest is due on a payment of Inheritance Tax 

 Inheritance Tax residence nil rate band ( RNRB ) calculator 
 Calculate the RNRB if a home is left to direct descendants 

 Inheritance Tax reduced rate calculator 
 Check if you qualify to pay a reduced rate of Inheritance Tax 

 Inheritance Tax grossing up calculator 
 Calculate the chargeable estate, when the will has ‘free of tax’ gifts and the residue is partly or completely exempt 

 Inheritance Tax: guaranteed annuity calculator 
 Work out an estimated market value of guaranteed annuity payments when valuing assets of the deceased’s estate 

 Inheritance Tax: quarters calculator for trusts 
 Work out the number of quarters (3-month periods) when Inheritance Tax is charged on a trust for certain chargeable events 

 Work out how to apportion Agricultural and Business Relief for Inheritance Tax 
 Use this tool to work out how to apportion the £2.5 million allowance across property that qualifies for 100% agricultural relief or 100% business relief. 

 National Insurance

 Tool 
 What it does 

 Claim a National Insurance refund 
 Apply for a refund on your National Insurance contributions 

 Director’s National Insurance contributions calculator 
 Work out a company director’s National Insurance contributions for the current tax year 

 National Insurance contributions calculator 
 Work out employer and employee National Insurance contributions for the current tax year 

 National Insurance if you work abroad 
 Check if you have to pay National Insurance in the UK while you’re working abroad 

 PAYE 

 Tool 
 What it does 

 Check if you can get Maternity or Paternity Leave or Pay, or Maternity Allowance 
 Check if you can get Statutory Maternity Leave or Pay, Statutory Paternity Leave or Pay or Maternity Allowance if you’re an employee 

 Check what your tax code means 
 Find out what the numbers and letters in your tax code mean and how much tax you will pay 

 Check how much tax you pay on dividends and interest from savings 
 Find out how tax on dividend income and interest from savings is worked out by HMRC . 

 PAYE tax calculator 
 Check your payroll calculations 

 PAYE tax and National Insurance payroll calculator 
 Check your PAYE tax and National Insurance payroll calculations manually 

 Basic PAYE tools 
 Tools to help you run your payroll 

 PAYE CHAPS 
 Request form for PAYE CHAPS transfer 

 Company car calculator 
 Calculate the company car tax charge based on a car’s taxable value and CO2 rating 

 Statutory Sick Pay calculator 
 Work out your employee’s Statutory Sick Pay 

 Maternity and paternity calculator 
 Work out your employee’s maternity or paternity pay and leave 

 PAYE Desktop Viewer 
 View your employee tax codes and notices 

 Stop PAYE payment booklet form 
 Stop receiving a PAYE payment booklet 

 Order P45s and P60s 
 Get P45s and P60s for your employees if you cannot produce these using your payroll software 

 PAYE and National Insurance contributions current year reference checker 
 Check your PAYE and National Insurance contributions reference for the current year 

 Statutory Neonatal Care Pay calculator 
 Calculate your employee’s Statutory Neonatal Care Pay 

 Statutory Parental Bereavement Pay calculator 
 Calculate your employee’s Statutory Parental Bereavement Pay 

 Work out pay from an umbrella company 
 Work out gross and net pay if you’re a worker or employment business using an umbrella company. 

 Pensions

 Tool 
 What it does 

 Guaranteed Minimum Pension ( GMP ) checker 
 Request GMP calculations 

 Pension annual allowance tool 
 Check your pension annual allowance 

 Self Assessment

 Tool 
 What it does 

 Estimate your Self Assessment tax bill 
 Estimate your Self Assessment tax bill 

 Lloyd’s calculator 
 Work out adjustments under section 107 Finance Act 2000 when filing your Self Assessment tax return 

 Work out your transition profit 
 Calculate your transition profit for the 2023 to 2024 tax year if you are affected by the new tax year basis (Basis Period Reform) 

 Self-employed

 Tool 
 What it does 

 Check what taxes may apply to you as a sole trader 
 Find out which taxes you might need to register for as a sole trader 

 Stamp Duty Land Tax ( SDLT )

 Tool 
 What it does 

 SDLT calculator 
 Work out how much SDLT you need to pay when buying or transferring land or property 

 SDLT CHAPS request 
 Request to pay SDLT by CHAPS 

 VAT 

 Tool 
 What it does 

 VAT payment deadline calculator 
 Work out the VAT payment deadline for your accounting period 

 VAT registration estimator 
 Check what registering for VAT may mean for your business 

 EU VAT number validation on the European Commission website 
 Check a VAT number from any EU country to help you complete an EC Sales List 

 VAT CHAPS request 
 Request to pay VAT by CHAPS
changeNote: A 'Deadlines' section has been added to help you find out the filing and payment deadlines for your taxes, and add them to your calendar.
